synopsis: Motional is an on-road autonomy vendor whose published methods provide evidence for layered validation, not verified sign-off for heavy off-road machines [f15718, f15728]. Its documented progression moves from complementary synthetic simulation and re-simulation of recorded data through closed-course and public-road testing to deployment [f517, f695, f15725]. Its 2026 safety material describes daily testing and shadow-mode feature deployment before broader roll-out; in shadow mode, software produces decisions that vehicle actuators do not execute [f586, f15726, f15727]. The booklet uses Motional and Waymo to support simulation, replay and shadow mode as filters before scarce physical testing—not substitutes for it—and staged release within a limited operating domain [f15729, f15730]. Neither company discloses validation durations or physical-test shares that would count as verified sign-off, leaving those planning quantities unresolved [f15728].
